description: This file is a shell script used for configuring and managing GRE tunnels and Hotspot functionalities, including creating/destructing tunnels, setting firewall rules, managing SSIDs, and handling hotspot processes in a network device environment.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Reads configuration parameters for a GRE tunnel instance from external sources.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events related to DHCP snooping for hotspot.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events for keepalive policies in hotspot.

methods.name: get_ssids
methods.description: Retrieves SSIDs associated with a hotspot bridge.

methods.name: set_ssids_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables SSIDs and associated radios.

methods.name: check_ssids
methods.description: Checks and updates the state of SSIDs based on network conditions.

methods.name: set_apisolation
methods.description: Configures API partitioning for hotspot SSIDs.

methods.name: start_hotspot
methods.description: Initializes and starts hotspot services for a given GRE tunnel instance.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates a GRE tunnel with specified remote endpoint.

methods.name: set_br_fw_rules
methods.description: Configures firewall rules for a GRE tunnel and bridge.

methods.name: configure_hotspot
methods.description: Sets up hotspot parameters and firewall rules for a given tunnel and bridge.

methods.name: set_firewall_rules
methods.description: Determines if a bridge is a hotspot bridge and applies relevant firewall rules.

methods.name: bring_up_bridge_on_boot
methods.description: Brings up a network bridge if not already active during system boot.

methods.name: stop_hotspot
methods.description: Terminates hotspot processes and cleans up GRE tunnel interfaces.

methods.name: delete_tunnel
methods.description: Deletes a GRE tunnel instance and associated interfaces.

methods.name: find_active_gre_tunnels
methods.description: Detects all active GRE tunnels and recreates them if necessary.
